visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black shirt, speaks directly to the camera in front of a wall-to-wall bookshelf packed with manga and books. He holds a book over his head to simulate earthquake protection. (2) The scene cuts to a black cat with a bow tie sitting upright, then to a cartoon animation of a building shaking where a character falls out a window. This is followed by a real-world clip of someone falling on an escalator in a wheelchair. (3) The man returns to the frame, holding up three fingers to explain different earthquake behaviors. He gestures downward to emphasize floor levels. (4) A clip shows three people lying face-down in a hallway. Then, a snippet from SpongeBob SquarePants shows Squidward leaning close to Patrick. (5) Brief clips of an anime character blasting fire and a seal bumping into an aquarium wall are shown. (6) The man continues his explanation, followed by clips of SpongeBob blowing bubbles and Homer Simpson pushing a man in a wheelchair. (7) The final shot shows the man pointing towards a logo for 'sci-tech vista' which appears in the top left corner of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 坐輪椅的人地震怎麼辦? [Variety]: 坐輪椅的人地震怎麼辦? (2) [Subtitle]: 趴下 掩護 穩住. (3) [Subtitle]: 問題來了 坐輪椅怎麼趴? 怎麼掩護? 怎麼穩住啊? (4) [Subtitle]: 成大跟國家災防科技中心的研究團隊決定 把輪椅放上震動台 實驗看看. (5) [Subtitle]: 他們發現 輪椅在地震中會有三種行為 往前滑動 左右搖晃 整台翻倒 而且這竟然跟你住幾樓有關. (6) [Subtitle]: 一到九樓 輪椅最容易往前滑 十到十三樓 是側翻風險最高的區間 十四樓以上呢 前滑、側翻、後翻都有可能. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以對應的方法不能一樣 低樓層的 只要壓低身體 抓穩固定物 就能降低風險. (8) [Subtitle]: 中樓層就要讓輪椅靠牆擺 並加裝防傾桿. (9) [Subtitle]: 要是在高樓層 那你最好事前做好準備 設計好能固定輪椅的位置 地震來時才撐得住. (10) [Subtitle]: 不只是輪椅使用者 照護者也要知道怎麼防震 所以說 客製化很重要 防災設計該為不同身體狀態的人量身打造. (11) [Subtitle]: 想知道更多防災策略嗎 點進科技大觀園. [Logo]: sci-tech vista 科技大觀園. [Logo]: 廣告.
